business_summary: Kyosha Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing and sale of printed wiring boards and carrier jigs for mounting electrical components in Japan, China, Indonesia, Mexico, and Vietnam. The company offers single and double-sided, multi-layered, double-sided copper/silver paste through-hole, long, and aluminum paste PWBs; dustless construction method Kyosha-Max; and printed wiring boards (PWBs) designing services. It also provides MagiCarrier, a carrier jig for printed boards and micro-components; MagiCarrier-ß, a double-sided adhesive sheet with high heat resistance; MagiCarrier-DIP, a carrier for flow soldering; and MagiFix Holder, a holding jig for printed boards during solder printing and mounting. In addition, the company offers Eco-flash a, a cleaning fluid solution for soldering carrier; Bubble washer, a washer that uses soldering carrier cleaning fluid and air bubbling to remove flux contamination; and jig products, such as hand soldering, lead forming, coating application, and dip tester jigs. Further, it provides metal mask, including laser metal mask for high-precision mounting; COB mask for uneven PWB surfaces; and PH mask for uneven surfaces of FPC and ceramic boards. Additionally, the company offers electronic component mounting and quality inspection services. It serves automotive, home appliance, office equipment, and electronic device sectors. The company was formerly known as Kyoto Shashingata Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kyosha Co., Ltd. in November 1982. Kyosha Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
